summary: Patient missed the appointment because she did not receive a reminder message and forgot the schedule.
recommended_action: Verify patient contact details, update communication preferences, and assist with rescheduling for next week.

summary: Patient missed the appointment because they live far from the clinic and were unable to secure transport on the morning of the visit.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth options for routine check-ups or provide local transportation assistance information.

summary: Patient skipped the appointment due to high consultation fees this month and inquired about possible follow-up discounts.
recommended_action: Provide information regarding financial assistance programs, payment plans, or available follow-up discounts.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to high fever and body ache, and plans to reschedule upon recovery.
recommended_action: Send an automated check-in message after a few days to assist the patient in rescheduling once recovered.

summary: The patient missed the appointment due to an urgent office meeting and requested an evening slot for future visits.
recommended_action: Offer flexible evening appointment slots and send calendar invites to help manage work conflicts.

summary: Patient forgot the appointment because they did not receive an SMS reminder and now wishes to reschedule.
recommended_action: Enable automated multi-channel reminder notifications and assist the patient with quick rebooking.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a city bus strike and lack of available transport from their location.
recommended_action: Provide information on accessible transit options, offer telehealth alternatives, or assist with specialized patient transport services.

summary: Patient could not be reached as their phone was switched off after three attempts.
recommended_action: Send an automated SMS or letter inviting the patient to reschedule at their convenience.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a factory shift change and inability to secure leave, preferring Saturday slots.
recommended_action: Offer flexible weekend appointment slots and provide advance scheduling options to accommodate work commitments.
